From: Tara Mills <tara@brightwave.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightwave.com
Date: Thu, 09 Nov 2028 08:22:00 -0500
Subject: Trouble claiming our supplier profile in Zip

Hi Hannah,

We tried to accept the supplier invite this morning but the portal is showing the wrong affiliation for our company. When we click "Claim organization" it lists an existing company called "BrightWave Holdings LLC" with a different tax ID and address — we are BrightWave Logistics (same parent but different legal entity). The form prevents us from entering our W-9 because it thinks the account is already claimed.

I've attached a screenshot and our W-9. Can you advise the best way to proceed? We're trying to finish onboarding so POs can route to our invoices (we have a PO due next week).

Attachments:
- brightwave_invite_screenshot.png (PNG, 640x480)
- brightwave_w9.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Thanks,

Sorry you're hitting this. I'm looping in Mina from our integration team — she can check tenant mapping and give a workaround so you can complete the W-9 and see POs.

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Tara Mills <tara@brightwave.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Nov 2028 11:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Trouble claiming our supplier profile in Zip

Hi Tara — I've looked into the logs and this looks like an affiliation / tenant mapping mismatch. Quick summary:

- The invite you received targets the tenant id for "BrightWave Holdings LLC" (tenant: bw-holdings).
- BrightWave Logistics exists as a separate legal entity in our vendor registry (tenant: bw-logistics) but the original invite was generated against the holdings tenant.
- Zip's claim flow blocks the W-9 upload if a different legal entity is pre-associated with the invite.

Two options to resolve quickly:
1) I can generate a one-time claim link scoped to bw-logistics. Use that link to claim the correct company immediately (recommended). Link: https://zip.redwood.com/one-time/claim?token=otk-7a3f
2) We can reissue an invite pointing explicitly at the bw-logistics tenant (this takes ~24 hours to propagate to the portal).

I'm attaching the tenant mapping extract and a short trace that shows where the invite was tied to the wrong tenant. If you want me to create the one-time link now I will — it will let you complete the W-9 and then you'll see active POs once our routing completes (should be within an hour of claim).

Attachments:
- tenant-mapping-log.txt (text)

Let me know which you prefer and if you want the payments team to hold routing.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Integrations Engineer, Onboarding
Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com
